headline: My therapist calls it people-pleasing, but I prefer to think of it as RESPONSIVE DESIGN. I just rearrange my entire self to fit the room.
caption:
My therapist calls it people-pleasing, but I prefer to think of it as RESPONSIVE DESIGN. I just rearrange my entire self to fit the room.

RESPONSIVE DESIGN: a layout that rearranges itself to fit whatever screen it is shown on.
